mechanism_narrative: The Federal Funds Rate at or below 0.25% indicates the Federal Reserve has implemented the lowest possible interest rate, compressing discount rates for equity valuation and stimulating risk-taking, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over the past three months indicates accelerating labor market recovery, increasing household disposable income and corporate profit expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE declines > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates synchronized expansion across manufacturing and consumer sectors, reducing double-dip recession risk and boosting corporate earnings visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both INDPRO and RSAFS rise in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase (UNRATE > 8.0% and declining), a monthly increase in the CPI index exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises >0.5% in 1 month during a post-recession recovery (UNRATE>8.0% and declining).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly growth rate in industrial production exceeding 0.5% indicates robust manufacturing activity, correlating with rising corporate profits and reduced recession risk, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO rises >0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts exceeding 5.0% signals a rebound in the housing sector, correlating with increased consumer wealth and construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST rises >5.0% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 90.0), a monthly growth rate in industrial production exceeding 0.5% indicates a stabilization in manufacturing, reducing prolonged recession risk and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO rises >0.5% in 1 month during a manufacturing contraction (INDPRO<90.0).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the Consumer Price Index exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, increasing the probability of Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises >0.3% in 1 month.
